# omadafusion_devices (Data Source)

Lists the site's adopted gateways, switches and access points.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_devices" "all" {}

output "disconnected_devices" {
  value = [for d in data.omadafusion_devices.all.devices : d.name if !d.connected]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Adopted devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the controller reports the device as connected.
- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version.
- `ip` (String) Management IP.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `model` (String) Model.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `type` (String) `gateway`, `switch` or `ap`.
